Offence P/U/S.498A Of Ipc And Sections 3 And 4 Of D.P
Act On The File Of The Learned V A.C.M.M Bengaluru.
 This Petition Coming On For Orders This Day,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
ORDER Learned HCGP accepts notice for the respondent No.1- State.
2. Sri. K. Mustafa, Advocate for respondent No.2 3.
The petitioner is sought to be prosecuted for the offence punishable under Section 498-A of IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

4. The case of the prosecution is that, the petitioner, who is the husband, subjected the de-facto complainant to cruelty both mentally and physically, and demanded to bring money from the parental home.

The parties are present before this Court and have filed an application under Section 320(2) r/w Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for compounding of the offences stating that they have amicably resolved the dispute among themselves and in terms of the settlement, the petitioner and second respondent are continuing to lead a cordial marital life NC: 2023:KHC:40964 as of date and second respondent has no objection for quashing the impugned FIR.
The application is placed on record.

5. Though the offences alleged are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably resolved the dispute among themselves, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioner is subjected to trial, since the probability of his conviction is remote and bleak, in view of the settlement.

Therefore, the continuation of the criminal proceedings will be an D Darshan Aradhya vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53667444/
